nodes.name: build-plugins.sh
nodes.summary: Builds every non-test plugin in the plugins/ directory as .oxp files and copies them into the correct system plugin folder for the current platform (Linux, macOS, or Windows), handling multi-architecture macOS builds and cross-compilation targets.

nodes.name: check-dco.sh
nodes.summary: Verifies that every commit in a git range carries a valid Signed-off-by DCO trailer matching the author's email, with special handling to skip commits authored by the Claude GitHub app.

nodes.name: check-display-crates.sh
nodes.summary: Ensures the Wayland and X11 Linux builds maintain strict crate separation — the Wayland build must not contain X11 crates and vice versa — by analyzing cargo tree output for both feature configurations.

nodes.name: check-plugin-template.sh
nodes.summary: Copies the plugin template to a temporary workspace, rewrites its dependencies to use the local checkout, then runs cargo fmt, clippy, tests, the plugin-test CLI, and a real file render to verify the template produces a working plugin.

nodes.name: guitar-pro-check.sh
nodes.summary: Converts all reference songs and test songs through the Guitar Pro plugins into .gp and .gp5 files for manual verification in Guitar Pro, logging all conversions to a tracked fixtures directory.

nodes.name: install-desktop-entry.sh
nodes.summary: Installs or uninstalls OxiGuitar's desktop entry, icon themes (16–512px plus SVG), and Guitar Pro MIME type registration for the current user on Linux, updating the desktop and MIME databases.

nodes.name: no-network.sh
nodes.summary: Runs strace on oxiguitar-cli and optionally the desktop app (under Weston or Xvfb) to detect any IPv4/IPv6 network connections during normal operation, failing the build if network access is detected.
